-- Retrospective research only. The calendar split is not proof of historical publication.
WITH races AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT id,race_date,track,race_no,turn,surface,distance,going,class_name,course_layout,field_size,source_ref,
 jsonb_build_array(track,turn,surface,distance,going,class_name,course_layout) AS condition
 FROM public.jra_lab_races
 WHERE race_date>=DATE '2024-01-01' AND race_date<DATE '2026-09-01'
 AND full_field AND source_ref IS NOT NULL AND surface IN ('芝','ダート')
 AND distance>0 AND turn IS NOT NULL AND going IS NOT NULL AND class_name IS NOT NULL
), rows AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT r.*,h.horse_no,h.finish,h.final3f,
 CASE WHEN h.time_raw~'^[0-9]+:[0-5][0-9][.][0-9]$'
 THEN split_part(h.time_raw,':',1)::numeric*60+split_part(h.time_raw,':',2)::numeric END elapsed
 FROM races r JOIN public.jra_lab_runs h ON h.race_id=r.id
 WHERE h.record_role='full_runner' AND h.source_kind='jra_public_reference'
), complete AS (
 SELECT id FROM rows GROUP BY id,field_size
 HAVING count(*)=field_size AND count(distinct horse_no)=field_size
 AND count(distinct finish)=field_size AND min(finish)=1 AND max(finish)=field_size
 AND count(*) FILTER(WHERE elapsed>0 AND final3f>0 AND final3f<elapsed)=field_size
 AND array_agg(elapsed ORDER BY finish)=array_agg(elapsed ORDER BY elapsed)
), eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT rows.* FROM rows JOIN complete USING(id)
), per_race AS (SELECT id,condition,race_date,count(*) n FROM eligible WHERE race_date<DATE '2026-07-01' GROUP BY id,condition,race_date), g AS (SELECT condition,count(*) n,count(DISTINCT date_trunc('month',race_date)) months FROM per_race GROUP BY condition), p AS (SELECT p.*,r.source_kind,r.archive_complete,r.course_layout,r.source_checked_at,r.class_name,r.surface FROM per_race p JOIN public.jra_lab_races r USING(id)), refs AS (SELECT p.id,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(h.horse_ref),'') IS NOT NULL AND h.horse_ref<>'#') AS horse_refs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(h.jockey_ref),'') IS NOT NULL AND h.jockey_ref<>'#') AS jockey_refs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(h.trainer_ref),'') IS NOT NULL AND h.trainer_ref<>'#') AS trainer_refs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE h.weight_carried>0) AS weights FROM p JOIN public.jra_lab_runs h ON h.race_id=p.id WHERE h.record_role='full_runner' AND h.source_kind='jra_public_reference' GROUP BY p.id) SELECT count(*) AS races,sum(p.n) AS runners,count(*) FILTER(WHERE p.source_kind='jra_public_reference') AS race_source_kind_match,count(*) FILTER(WHERE archive_complete) AS archive_complete,count(*) FILTER(WHERE nullif(btrim(course_layout),'') IS NOT NULL) AS layout_present,count(*) FILTER(WHERE source_checked_at IS NOT NULL) AS checked_present,count(*) FILTER(WHERE source_checked_at<'2026-07-01 00:00:00+09'::timestamptz) AS checked_before_holdout,count(*) FILTER(WHERE source_checked_at<(race_date+1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Tokyo') AS checked_before_next_day,count(*) FILTER(WHERE horse_refs=p.n) AS all_horse_refs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE jockey_refs=p.n) AS all_nonplaceholder_jockey_refs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE trainer_refs=p.n) AS all_nonplaceholder_trainer_refs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE weights=p.n) AS all_positive_weights,(SELECT count(*) FROM g WHERE n<5) AS groups_lt5,(SELECT count(*) FROM g WHERE n BETWEEN 5 AND 19) AS groups5_19,(SELECT count(*) FROM g WHERE n>=20) AS groups20,(SELECT count(*) FROM g WHERE n>=20 AND months>=6) AS groups20_6months FROM p JOIN refs USING(id);
